evaluation: Archived paired camera ablation of the selected policy stack

protocol.scope: Earlier evaluation with small cup-position offsets; separate from the strictly centered 199/200 evaluation.
protocol.success: Centered bilateral grasp, >=6 cm cup-bottom clearance, stable 0.5-second hold
protocol.image_transform_applies_to: Both input frames for the manager and both force experts; proprioception unchanged

conditions.frozen: The two-frame reset image repeated for the entire episode
conditions.black: Every image pixel replaced by zero; not grayscale

interpretation: Supports dependence on camera input. Unfamiliar black or frozen images may disrupt the policy; this does not by itself establish robust cup tracking or show that the task cannot be learned without vision.
